title: Carbon Prices and Fuel Switching: A Quasi-experiment in Electricity Markets
How Regional Policies Reduce Carbon Emissions in Electricity Markets: Fuel Switching or Emission Leakage
Impact of Collective Rights-based Fisheries Management: Evidence from New England Groundfish Fishery
abstract: This article uses a trip-level dataset to analyze the impact of a collective rights-based management system (“sectors”) introduced in the New England groundfish fishery in 2010. We examine the change of a number of outcome variables, including effort, species diversity, and location diversity. We then examine whether participation in sectors led to shifts in the production frontier and/or changes in technical efficiency using stochastic frontier models. Our results suggest that participation in sectors appears to have impacted trawl vessels more than gillnet vessels, likely due to the different ways in which the effort regulations in place under the common-pool regime impacted these vessel types. In addition, sector participation appears to have an impact on behavioral responses (i.e., changes in effort and diversity of species and locations) rather than technical efficiency, despite some evidence that sector participation led to shifts in the production frontiers of both vessel types.
abstract_zh: 本文利用航次层面的数据集，分析2010年在新英格兰底栖鱼类渔业中引入的基于集体权利的管理制度（“sectors”）的影响。我们考察了若干结果变量的变化，包括捕捞努力量、物种多样性和作业地点多样性。随后，我们利用随机前沿模型，考察参与sectors是否导致生产前沿发生移动和/或技术效率发生变化。结果表明，参与sectors对拖网渔船的影响似乎大于刺网渔船，这可能是因为在公共池塘制度下实施的捕捞努力量管制对这两类渔船的作用方式不同。此外，尽管有证据表明参与sectors使两类渔船的生产前沿都发生了移动，但sectors参与的影响主要体现在行为反应（即捕捞努力量以及物种和作业地点多样性的变化）上，而非技术效率。

title: Have U.S. Power Plants Become Less Technically Efficient? The Impact of Carbon Emission Regulation
Media, Protest Diffusion, and Authoritarian Resilience
Sorting by Regulation and Racial Segregation
The Dynamic Efficiency Costs of Common Property Resource Exploitation
Benefits of Rebuilding Global Marine Fisheries Outweigh Costs
abstract: Global marine fisheries are currently underperforming, largely due to overfishing. An analysis of global databases finds that resource rent net of subsidies from rebuilt world fisheries could increase from the current negative US$13 billion to positive US$54 billion per year, resulting in a net gain of US$600 to US$1,400 billion in present value over fifty years after rebuilding. To realize this gain, governments need to implement a rebuilding program at a cost of about US$203 (US$130-US$292) billion in present value. We estimate that it would take just 12 years after rebuilding begins for the benefits to surpass the cost. Even without accounting for the potential boost to recreational fisheries, and ignoring ancillary and non-market values that would likely increase, the potential benefits of rebuilding global fisheries far outweigh the costs.
abstract_zh: 全球海洋渔业目前表现欠佳，很大程度上是由过度捕捞所致。对全球数据库的分析发现，经重建的世界渔业扣除补贴后的资源租金，可能从目前每年负130亿美元提高到每年正540亿美元，在重建完成后的五十年内，折现价值的净收益可达6000亿至1.4万亿美元。要实现这一收益，各国政府需要实施一项重建计划，其折现成本约为2030亿美元（1300亿至2920亿美元）。我们估计，重建开始后仅需12年，收益就将超过成本。即使不计入对休闲渔业的潜在提振，并忽略可能进一步增加的附带价值和非市场价值，重建全球渔业的潜在收益也远远超过其成本。

title: Impact of the Deepwater Horizon Well Blowout on the Economics of US Gulf Fisheries
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: Marine oil spills usually harm organisms at two interfaces: near the water surface and on shore. However, because of the depth of the April 2010 Deepwater Horizon well blowout, deeper parts of the Gulf of Mexico are likely impacted. We estimate the potential negative economic effects of this blowout and oil spill on commercial and recreational fishing, as well as mariculture (marine aquaculture) in the US Gulf area, by computing potential losses throughout the fish value chain. We find that the spill could, in the next 7 years, result in (midpoint) present value losses of total revenues, total profits, wages, and economic impact of US$3.7, US$1.9, US$1.2, and US$8.7 billion, respectively. Commercial and recreational fisheries would likely suffer the most losses, with a respective estimated US$1.6 and US$1.9 billion of total revenue losses, US$0.8 and US$1.1 billion in total profit losses, and US$4.9 and US$3.5 billion of total economic losses.
abstract_zh: 海洋溢油通常会对两个界面的生物造成危害：水面附近和海岸。然而，由于2010年4月“深水地平线”（Deepwater Horizon）油井井喷事故的发生深度很大，墨西哥湾较深的水域也很可能受到影响。我们通过计算整个鱼类价值链上的潜在损失，估计此次井喷和溢油事故对美国墨西哥湾地区商业捕捞、休闲捕捞以及海水养殖（海洋水产养殖）的潜在负面经济影响。我们发现，在未来7年内，此次溢油可能导致总收入、总利润、工资和经济影响分别产生（中点估计的）现值损失37亿、19亿、12亿和87亿美元。商业捕捞和休闲捕捞可能遭受的损失最大，其总收入损失分别估计为16亿和19亿美元，总利润损失分别为8亿和11亿美元，总经济损失分别为49亿和35亿美元。

title: Managing Bluefin Tuna in the Mediterranean Sea
Measuring Welfare Losses from Hypoxia: the Case of North Carolina Brown Shrimp
Management of an Annual Fishery in the Presence of Ecological Stress: The Case of Shrimp and Hypoxia
abstract: The emergence of ecosystem-based management suggests that traditional fisheries management and protection of environmental quality are increasingly interrelated. But fishery managers have limited control over most sources of marine and estuarine pollution and at best can only adapt to environmental conditions. This paper presents a bioeconomic model of optimal harvest of an annual species that is subject to an environmental disturbance, and parameterizes the model to analyze the effect of hypoxia (low dissolved oxygen) on the optimal harvest path of brown shrimp, a commercially important species that is fished in hypoxic waters in the Gulf of Mexico and in estuaries in the southeastern United States. We find that hypoxia alters the qualitative pattern of optimal harvest and shifts the season opening earlier in the year; more severe hypoxia leads to even earlier season openings. Failure to adapt to hypoxia leads to greater losses when the effects of hypoxia are more severe. However, rent gains from adapting fishery management to hypoxia are relatively small compared to rent losses from the hypoxia effect itself. This suggests that it is critical for other regulatory agencies to control estuarine pollution, and fishery managers need to generate value from the fishery resources through other means such as rationalization.
abstract_zh: 生态系统管理的兴起表明，传统渔业管理与环境质量保护正日益相互关联。但渔业管理者对大多数海洋和河口污染源的控制能力有限，最多只能适应环境条件。本文提出了一个关于受环境扰动的一年生物种最优捕捞的生物经济模型，并以墨西哥湾及美国东南部河口中捕捞的重要商业物种褐对虾为对象进行参数化，分析缺氧（溶解氧含量低）对最优捕捞路径的影响。我们发现，缺氧改变了最优捕捞的定性模式，并使渔季开放时间提前；缺氧越严重，渔季开放越早。当缺氧影响更严重时，未能适应缺氧所造成的损失也更大。然而，相较于缺氧效应本身造成的租金损失，通过使渔业管理适应缺氧所获得的租金收益相对较小。这表明，其他监管机构控制河口污染至关重要，而渔业管理者则需要通过理顺渔业资源（如权利配置）等其他途径来创造价值。

title: Quantifying the Economic Effects of Hypoxia on a Fishery for Brown Shrimp (Farfantepenaeus aztecus)
abstract: Although hypoxia is a threat to coastal ecosystems, policy makers have limited information about its economic impacts on fisheries. Studies using spatially and temporally aggregated data generally fail to detect statistically significant effects of hypoxia on fisheries. Limited recent work using disaggregated fishing data (microdata) has revealed modest effects of hypoxia on the catches of recreationally harvested species. These studies did not account for important spatial and temporal aspects of the system, however. For example, the effects of hypoxia on catch may not materialize instantaneously but involve a lagged process reflecting cumulative past exposure. This paper develops a differenced bioeconomic model to account for the lagged effects of hypoxia on the North Carolina fishery for brown shrimp Farfantepenaeus aztecus. The model integrates high-resolution oxygen monitoring data with fishery-dependent microdata from North Carolina's trip ticket program to investigate the detailed spatial and temporal relationships of hypoxia to commercial fishery harvests. The main finding is that hypoxia may have resulted in a 12.9% annual decrease in the brown shrimp harvest during the period 1999–2005. The paper also develops two alternative models—a nondifferenced model and a polynomial distributed lag model—whose results are consistent with those of the main model.
abstract_zh: 尽管缺氧是对沿海生态系统的威胁，政策制定者对其经济影响的信息却十分有限。使用空间和时间上加总的数据进行的研究，通常无法检测到缺氧对渔业产生的统计显著影响。近期一些利用分解程度较高的渔业数据（微观数据）的有限研究，发现缺氧对休闲捕捞物种的渔获量有适度影响。然而，这些研究未能考虑系统中重要的空间和时间维度。例如，缺氧对渔获量的影响可能不会立即显现，而是涉及反映过去累积暴露的滞后过程。本文构建了一个差分生物经济模型，以考虑缺氧对北卡罗来纳州褐对虾（Farfantepenaeus aztecus）渔业的滞后效应。该模型整合了高分辨率的氧气监测数据与北卡罗来纳州渔获单计划（trip ticket program）中依赖渔业的微观数据，以考察缺氧与商业渔获之间详细的空间和时间关系。主要发现是，在1999—2005年期间，缺氧可能导致褐对虾年渔获量下降12.9%。本文还构建了两种替代模型——非差分模型和多项式分布滞后模型——其结果与主模型一致。
